title: Spec-Plan Deviation Whitelist Entry
description: Schema for a single whitelisted deviation between the project specification and the implementation plan. Used to explicitly allow known contradictions (e.g., data source substitutions) so verification scripts do not fail on them.

spec_requirement.description: The specific requirement ID or text from the spec (e.g., 'FR-001' or 'NOAA/PRISM') that is being deviated from.

implemented_source.description: The actual source, library, or method used in the implementation instead of the spec requirement.

reason.description: Justification for the deviation (e.g., 'Data unavailable', 'Plan explicitly substitutes...').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the deviation was approved/recorded.
